//: Tells the C# Dev Kit, OmniSharp, and .NET Install Tool extensions where to find the dotnet binary when it isn't on the system PATH.
//1: Required on Linux when .NET was installed via dotnet-install.sh (default location: $HOME/.dotnet) and VS Code was launched from a desktop session that did not source ~/.bashrc / ~/.profile.
//2: Windows devs: this path will not resolve. Override in your User settings (Ctrl+,) or set DOTNET_ROOT — the installer adds dotnet to system PATH so this setting is harmless if dotnet is already discoverable.
